name: animated-tabs
title: Animated Tabs
description: Tabs with a spring-animated indicator that slides between items.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the active tab value on change.

accessibility: Implements the tabs pattern with role="tablist"/"tab", aria-selected, and a roving tabindex. Arrow keys, Home, and End move between tabs.
touch: No pointer-following. Tapping a tab activates it and slides the indicator.
reducedMotion: The indicator snaps instantly instead of springing.
